from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]

    def lines(matrix, length):
        result = []
        for i, line in enumerate(matrix):
            color, count = Counter(line).most_common(1)[0]
            if color != background and count >= length - 2:
                result.append(i)
        return result

    rs = lines(grid, w)
    cs = lines([[grid[r][c] for r in range(h)] for c in range(w)], h)
    if not rs or not cs:
        return [[background]]

    # Read the colored crossings of the repeated grid lines, omitting
    # the outermost top and left guide lines.
    rsel = rs[:-1] if len(rs) > 1 else rs
    csel = cs[1:] if len(cs) > 1 else cs
    out = [[grid[r][c] for c in csel] for r in rsel]

    # Remove trailing rows or columns that are only the ordinary background.
    while len(out) > 1 and all(v == background for v in out[-1]):
        out.pop()
    while len(out[0]) > 1 and all(row[-1] == background for row in out):
        for row in out:
            row.pop()
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    all_counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    common = all_counts.most_common()

    # Find full-length separator lines. Their predominant color is the
    # lattice color; colored interruptions at crossings are retained.
    def find_lines(lines, length):
        found = []
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            color, count = Counter(line).most_common(1)[0]
            if count >= length - 2:
                found.append((i, color))
        return found

    row_lines = find_lines(grid, w)
    col_lines = find_lines(
        [[grid[r][c] for r in range(h)] for c in range(w)], h
    )
    if len(row_lines) < 2 or len(col_lines) < 2:
        return [[common[0][0]]]

    rs = [i for i, _ in row_lines]
    cs = [i for i, _ in col_lines]

    # Background is the most frequent color away from the separator lines.
    excluded_rows, excluded_cols = set(rs), set(cs)
    interior = [
        grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in excluded_rows
        for c in range(w) if c not in excluded_cols
    ]
    background = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0] if interior else common[0][0]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rs) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cs) - 1):
            corners = (
                grid[rs[i]][cs[j]], grid[rs[i]][cs[j + 1]],
                grid[rs[i + 1]][cs[j]], grid[rs[i + 1]][cs[j + 1]]
            )
            row.append(corners[0] if len(set(corners)) == 1 else background)
        out.append(row)

    # Trailing all-background intervals are outside the depicted pattern.
    while len(out) > 1 and all(v == background for v in out[-1]):
        out.pop()
    while out and len(out[0]) > 1 and all(row[-1] == background for row in out):
        for row in out:
            row.pop()
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    def separators(lines, length):
        found = []
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            color, count = Counter(line).most_common(1)[0]
            if color != background and count >= length - 2:
                found.append((i, color))
        return found

    rows = separators(grid, w)
    cols = separators([[grid[r][c] for r in range(h)] for c in range(w)], h)
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [[background]]

    grid_color = Counter(color for _, color in rows + cols).most_common(1)[0][0]
    result = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        outrow = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            value = grid[rows[i][0]][cols[j][0]]
            outrow.append(background if value == grid_color else value)
        result.append(outrow)
    return result
